domain: Surcharges, penalties and interest on late tax

rules.statement: Filing late without a prior demand carries a surcharge of 1 percent plus a further 1 percent for each complete month of delay, up to 12 months. From month 13 the surcharge is a flat 15 percent plus late-payment interest running from the day after month 12.
rules.notes: This replaced the old 5/10/15/20 tiers via Ley 11/2021. No interest is charged in the first 12 months. A schedule of 5 percent every three months to a maximum of 20 is the pre-2021 regime and no longer applies.

rules.statement: The surcharge excludes any penalty that could otherwise have been imposed.
The surcharge is reduced by 25 percent where the conditions of art. 27.5 LGT are met, essentially full payment within the voluntary payment period opened by the notification.

source.name: AEAT sede electronica
source.ref: art. 27.5 LGT, Recargos aplicables, Manual IRPF 2025

rules.statement: Once the tax office has issued a demand the surcharge regime no longer applies and the conduct becomes a tax infraction, with a minimum proportional fine of 50 percent of the amount unpaid.
rules.notes: PARTIAL: art. 191 could not be read verbatim, the consolidated LGT truncates. Confirm before this figure appears in public copy. A tool must present the voluntary and demanded routes as separate branches, never blending 1 percent per month with a 50 percent fine.

rules.statement: For 2026 the legal interest rate is 3.25 percent and the late-payment interest rate is 4.0625 percent.

source.name: AEAT sede electronica
source.ref: Otras cuestiones de interes, Manual IRPF 2025

rules.notes: Set annually. Same figures applied in 2025.
